body: I assume this does not happen if you perform a `clean`  first?
Not sure what you mean with `clean` first, but if I don't let quarkus:dev run while updating the POM it just works. It only fails while quarkus:dev is running when I modify the pom.
I mean doing an `mvn clean` between version updates

Is not necessary:

```
$ mvn quarkus:dev
... (powered by Quarkus 2.5.0.Final)
^C
```
update pom

```
$ mvn quarkus:dev
... (powered by Quarkus 2.5.1.Final)
```
That's my point... If you do clean between pom updates, do you get the problem?
No, I don't get the problem when I do a clean between upgrades.
@aloubyansky is this something that is expected to work without a recompile? I would assume not..
No, we don't guarantee it working across versions. Basically, if you upgrade, you should rebuild the app. I actually saw this NPE in a branch I am working on, so I'll fix the NPE, at least.
Sounds fair. Would be awesome if it works though, but I can imagine you won't guarantee it working.

If it's not supposed to work, is there a way to detect it's happening and display a proper error message?

IIRC, @stuartwdouglas made it possible to add dependencies to the pom while in dev mode so I suppose it's only broken if you update Quarkus itself?

> so I suppose it's only broken if you update Quarkus itself?

that is my understanding of the issue

> so I suppose it's only broken if you update Quarkus itself?

AFAIK yes. I did not upgrade any dependencies other than updating the quarkus version property, which of course causes the quarkus BOM and plugins to be upgraded.
We definitely can't guarantee this will work. Some versions it might, others it won't, but it's not something we want to spend time on.
Maybe we can at least throw an ISE with a good error message instead of a NPE. I assume that's what @aloubyansky meant in his comment above

issue.title: Provide meaningful error message when updating Quarkus in dev-mode
